title: Rate-limit test bypasses HTTP response error detection
reasoning: The mocked post call raises HTTPStatusError directly. An HTTP 429 normally arrives as an httpx.Response; status validation raises the exception. This test therefore verifies retry handling only after detection and would still pass if the grader stopped checking response status, leaving actual rate-limit responses unretried.
recommendation: Extend the existing retry scenario so post returns the 429 response followed by the successful response, exercising status detection and retry together.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The only included rate-limit scenario injects the exception at the transport call instead of returning an error response.
suggestedRegressionTest: Return a 429 response followed by a successful grading response, then assert two awaited requests and the expected parsed grades.
